# Sources List

## Entry format

```
### [<Key>] Author(s), "Short Title" (Year)

**Full title:** the title as printed on the work
**Authors:** every author, as printed
**Year:** the year of the printing that was read
**Cached text:** `evidence/cache/<Key>.txt` (fetched YYYY-MM-DD, sha256 ...)
**Findings:** see `evidence/says.md`
```
